correctness.rationale: PASS: For k>=2 clique blocks, hub-to-leaf and within-block snowflake distances are 1, cross-block squared distances r=2^(2alpha). A positive weighted variance identity using p_i proportional to 1/b_i, b_i=(r-1+1/m_i)/2, proves c2^2>=R^2=r/2-1/sum_i 1/b_i, in addition to >=1. Orthogonal block simplices and a hub at (or perpendicular to) their common weighted circumcenter realize exactly max(1,R^2). Equality in the strictly positive weights determines all pair distances and congruence of optimum. The leaf affine rank is N-1, the hub adds one dimension iff R²<1. Strict monotonicity of the weighted-max expression and r=1/4 endpoint establish the unique alpha threshold, including the k=2 singleton endpoint. Independent Gram/PSD/distance checks covered 416 leaf pairs; finite tests are supplemental.
